title: Who Actually Makes open data: who makes store brands, from public records
description: Who makes store-brand products, from public records. 19 datasets, 15,748 records: Who makes what: store-brand answers (Kirkland Signature); Companies behind store brands (maker pages); Which store labels each company is on record for; Tire plant codes (NHTSA); Tire age guidance from tire makers, carmakers and agencies; Evidence records: every quote behind our answers; Sources: the public records we use, and their limits; Corrections log; Update schedule: when each list is checked; Costco diaper prices: every size at every read; Kirkland vs name brands: every pair and its verdict; Car battery date code rules, by brand; USDA meat, poultry and egg plants (FSIS directory); Subaru, Kia and Toyota rows in NHTSA's AALA reports, model years 2018 on; Insignia model numbers on California's appliance register; Hart, Hyper Tough, Husky and Harbor Freight battery chargers on California's appliance register; Craftsman model numbers and the companies government records name for them; Onn TV model numbers and the manufacturers California's appliance register lists for them; Trader Joe's wine, beer and spirits label approvals (TTB). JSON and CSV. Live copy and API: https://whoactuallymakes.com/data/
